Role Description The Brand Consultant is a full-time remote role responsible for strengthening and evolving TiSUN Energy’s brand across digital and offline channels. This role involves developing and refining brand positioning, messaging, and visual identity to clearly communicate the company’s value in sustainable energy solutions. Day-to-day tasks include conducting brand audits, analyzing market and competitor insights, collaborating with marketing and sales teams on campaigns, and ensuring consistent brand application across presentations, proposals, and customer touchpoints. The Brand Consultant will create brand guidelines, support content and creative teams, and provide strategic input on how the brand is represented during client engagements and industry events. This role also requires monitoring brand performance metrics and recommending improvements to increase awareness, differentiation, and engagement.

Strong project management skills with the ability to work independently in a remote environment and meet deadlines across multiple initiatives.
Background in B2B branding, sustainability, or energy-related industries is beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
